changelog:
Initial release of Gaokao Volunteer skill – an AI-powered assistant for Chinese college application planning.

- Supports score matching, university recommendation, “冲稳保” (reach/match/safety) plan generation, and gradient checks.
- Covers all 31 provinces’ new and legacy Gaokao models.
- Guides users through structured multi-turn information collection.
- Automatically searches for batch lines, historical scores, and admission data.
- Runs algorithmic matching and generates detailed HTML application plans.
- Includes province-specific rules and key risk explanations; always provides disclaimers and source reminders.
summary: 高考志愿填报AI助手。基于位次法和线差法，提供分数匹配、 院校推荐、冲稳保方案生成、志愿梯度检查。覆盖全国31省新老高考模式。 Triggers: 填志愿, 高考志愿, 能上什么大学, 志愿填报, 冲稳保, 一分一段, 位次换算, gaokao, gaokao volunteer, 志愿推荐, 查分数线, 院校推...
